depends_on: A Shortcuts automation on your paging app's notification
description: Starts by itself when your paging app's notification runs a Shortcuts automation with Handle Event in it, which needs iOS 27; on iOS 26 you start it by hand. routinerun.com/help/on-call shows how. Its timers reach you with a card; set one to wake you if the phone will be face down.
